- Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production."

Leo (EngOps): Webhook mapping ready. Example payload: { "utm_campaign": "tri_launch", "interest": "dedicated" } Will need exact form slugs.
Isha (PM): Form question: "Which deployment are you evaluating?" values: hosted / dedicated / private. Map to lead tags for routing.
Evan (Design): A/B CTA test: "Register — See Benchmarks" vs "Register — Get Migration Playbook". I'll surface variant IDs in the design spec.
Nora (Marketing): Draft landing microcopy v1: "Ship features fast with Redwood Inference. One consistent API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Choose Hosted for rapid self-serve launches, Dedicated for predictable throughput, or Private to keep inference inside your VPC. Register for our webinar to see benchmark demos and migration playbooks."
Tom (Growth): Hero trimmed: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable performance." good for banner.
